. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on how many players there are in the match. The rewards received were based on how many waves were survived and if the match was won. This map had two difficulties, Easy and Hard.

Cash was only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This meant that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy was killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down.
Health of enemies in this mode scaled with player count and difficulty. In Easy, it was 5% in trio and 10% in quad. Hard difficulty had no health scaling.

We should have shot you when we had the chance.
Woah! Easy! We don't want to lose our minimal content rating!
The Rift Walker must have come here to find the other half of the cube. If the
is real, that would mean our realm is a part of it.
We have to save the Rift Walker. If he's connected to the realms, his death could destroy everything, and without them...
Everyone would be forced into the Nil Zone.

Now that we have the God Cube, our master will finally be reborn. We sacrifice so much to get to this point, and all that's left for us is the path of Exo. At one point we looked up to you, but no longer.
Now we can crush the heart of your organization until it stops beating.
Argh! He's placing a curse on us!
We need to find a way out of here, and fast. Maybe we can use that broken cannon somehow, but its parts are scattered everywhere. Commander, if we can find them in time, it might work again.

It was only a matter of time until that scientist or that elderly-hating duck messed with the cube — I just needed to bring them together! Once Ramiel used the card and messed up their portals, I hid a shard in their toilet! And... I'm monologuing, aren't I?
And you never even suspected me. Hahah!
All this existential crisis is wearing me out!
Let's talk about something fun! Like how Lefty and Righty can be hand puppets! 'Oh no! Don't kill us! Whaa!' 'You don't stand a chance! We have the God Cube! Hahaha!' Ahh— cracks me up every time.
Now that the God Cube is back together, our master will rise once more. Every step you took led us here.

After his body was destroyed, his soul was imprisoned within the cube. In our realms, he couldn't escape it due to the Rift Walker's influence since what he maintained was the cage that confined us. Although now within the Nil Zone, the Old World power from past battles here will set him free.
Is that the Pursuit? The Nil Zone can copy vehicles too?!
We can't let the Engineer find out about this. If you thought Exo was scary, Engineer is worse! She's as protective of her machines as Narrator is of his hands.
We messed up! Don't tell her!
Ramiel, why did you work at the outpost for so long anyway?
I wanted to show that I was better than them! Haha! They even gave me employee of the month!
That... surprisingly makes sense. Especially for you.
What are you trying to say?
I've waited long enough to destroy you. It's time for you to feel a fraction of what we've suffered.
Ooo! Oh, I do love a good revenge trope!
There he is, we need to take him down quickly!
Do you think you can defeat me? I swore that if we ever crossed paths again, I would make this personal.
Argh! No matter... the majority of the power has been absorbed into the Rift Walker. His fate is already sealed.

They used this place as a dumping ground to remove what was no longer wanted — to get rid of their problems with ease. The Rift Walker and his master can erase history in their own realms, but not here.
Here, their problems are back to haunt them.
The Nil Zone has even replicated the Brawler!
If they're anything like ours, they'll be able to jump past our defenses!
Brawler would have a field day fighting these things. I don't think anyone has faster reflexes than him.
I don't know about that. I heard from his sister that Assassin and Slasher are always training with him.
Watch out! The Null Accelerator just swapped the places of our units!
GIVE IT A REST ALREADY! What are you going to say next? 'Oh, Accelerator likes to eat hamburgers only on Monday and Friday!'?
This. This right here is why I hate you the most.
The Nil Zone's unstable energy was created from endless eons of war. Look at what it has done to your Necromancer. Imagine what it can do when it's harnessed.
War? Just what exactly is this place?
You only understand a fraction of our existence. The Rift Walker hid the truth from us, but no longer.
Can you sound any more flat? You're killing us!

Sinister destroyed our town's reputation after you left, but that's when we've discovered a shard — along with this clown. Our people left the town and were forced to abandon everything. You claim to be heroes, but you saved no one.
You've run out of time. It's too late now.
It's time to witness the dawn of a new era. One where all will kneel before Lord Exo.
OH SURE, HOW CONVENIENT! A LITERAL CANNON? Do the creators HATE US OR SOMETHING? THEY ALL SUCK!
This is bad! This is REALLY bad!
Focus everything we haveon Exo! We need to stop him here, otherwise everyone will be in danger! Grab the batteries around the area and load them into the cannon!

It was intentionally designed by the developers for hard mode on Night 3 to be impossible for solo. This is likely because:
All enemies have the same health regardless of the number of players (no health scaling).
Starting cash and wave bonuses are unaffected by the player count and the small amounts usually cannot cover a solid defense when played in solo.
Multiple enemies with higher health begin spawning as early as wave 1.
The Rift Walker starts with a 2,500,000 health pool when the
is not active. And if his Lord Exo's Rebirth ability is used and the star cannon was not used, the player could lose easily.
